summary: Phase 58 Master Delivery Report covering enterprise integration, email operations, recovery security, and live-provider verification. Validates 30/30 Phase 58 test items (TEST-P58-01 through TEST-P58-30), 706/706 master suite tests, lockfile protection, 10-mailbox inventory, 5-dimensional authorization model, OAuth PKCE, controlled pilot safety gates, enterprise operations monitoring API, administrator recovery security with dry-run support, PostgreSQL 6-state persistence, and VAWA Section 1367 confidential safeguarding isolation.
